method: Windows Chrome, checkout-owned persistent profile, pnpm browser:test. Same fresh quiet-document.md scratch copy; last paragraph scrolled to viewport bottom; secondary click near its right/bottom corner. Before uses baseCommit, after uses the raw Windows worktree source hashes above. Native browser chrome is not included in page PNGs.
manualReview: Inspected refreshed 1440px Light/English and 640px Dark/Korean same-state captures.
Checked row/icon vertical centres, padding, Korean labels, disabled state and shared danger styling.
Confirmed scrollbar/Outline clearance and unchanged menu coordinates with 8px viewport right/bottom clearance.
640px real overlap hit belongs to Delete; browser regression clicks that exact overlap and verifies deletion/Undo, unchanged notification button geometry and collapsed state.
Compared body, gutter, file and tab stacking using the separately documented diagnostic; all four menus now paint above the unchanged bell.
Manual captures are visual evidence, not screenshot assertions or owner approval.
reproduction: Copy capture.browser.js to apps/editor/test/body-context-capture.browser.js, set LITZIO_BROWSER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5282, and run pnpm browser:test body-context-capture.
Use phase=before with baseCommit source files, phase=after with the PR source. Preserve files between runs.
Remove the temporary scenario after capture; close caller-owned Vite and runner-owned browser sessions.

stackingReview.cause: Shared CommandMenu was inside the fixed document-scroll stacking context, beneath the notification center. File/tab ContextMenu portals were already above it. CommandMenu now escapes that context through a Portal at the existing menu layer; Table menus retain their Popover portal.
stackingReview.comparisonMethod: Open each existing menu normally, then temporarily translate its popup over the unchanged notification button for a same-point stacking diagnostic. Natural gutter/file/tab anchors do not overlap the bell; translation is diagnostic only and is not used in the published layout captures.
